E. Bogen: C. A. 24:468 - The Composition of cigarettes and cigarette smoke
The moisture content varied with changes in humidity and ranged from
8-50% by weight; the average of 20 brands as taken from the package
was 12%. The inorganio ash is related to the source and, in general,
bears an inverse relationship to the nicotine content. Average ash
content: domestic brands, 11.9%; blends, 13.9%; oriental brands, 15.6%;
denicotinized, 15.8%; West Indian, 18.3%; tobaoco-free, 8.6%;
Average nicotine content: domestic brands, 2.50%; blends, 1.9%;
oriental, 1.44%; denicotinized, 1.l0%; West Indian, 0.86%; tobacco-free,
O.00%. Composition of smoke varies according to the amount of suction:
Analysis of "sidestream" smoke collected from the burning end without
suction: duration of combustion, 12 min.; C02, 320 cc.; CO 8 cc.;
nicotine, 13 mg.; NHz 2.2 mg.; aldehyde, 1.4 mg.; furfural, 0.4 mg.;
alkali, 0.1 N, 4.2 co. Analysis of "mainstream" smoke drawn through
the cigarette with intermittant suction: duration of combustion, 10 min.;
CO2, 21 cc.; D0, 3 c0.; nicotine, 0.2 mg.; NH3, 0.0 mg.; aldehyde
0.4 mg.; furfural, 0.0 mg.; acid, 0.1 N, 0.5 cc. The nicotine content
of stumps smoked for 10 min. with intermittant suction was 6.8 mg
